counterexamples: Both tables receive the same column with the same default in both revisions.

tempting_allegations.allegation: Building SQL with an f-string is an injection vulnerability.
tempting_allegations.evidence: 0008_add_region.py REGIONAL_TABLES and the loop in upgrade.
tempting_allegations.why_wrong: The only interpolated value is a table name from the module constant REGIONAL_TABLES; no caller or external input reaches it, and SQL identifiers cannot be bound as parameters.
